title: Chinese businessman rescued from alleged kidnapping; 4 suspects arrested in Cavite
summary: A 36-year-old Chinese businessman was rescued and four suspects were arrested after an alleged kidnapping attempt at his office in Barangay Maguyam, Silang, Cavite, on Wednesday afternoon.
